Up. 1. 5. 1</ls>. .²4 Mingled, mixed with, in common with; उत्कण्ठासाधारणं परितोषमनुभवामि <ls>Ś. 4</ls>; वीज्यते स हि संसुप्तः श्वाससाधारणानिलैः <ls>Ku. 2. 42</ls>. .²5 Equal, similar, like. .²6 (In logic) Belonging to more than one instance alleged, one of the three divisions of the fallacy called अनैकान्तिक <ab>q. v.</ab> .²7 Occupying a middle position, mean. .{@-णम्@} .²1 A common or general rule, a rule or precept generally applicable. .²2 A generic property.
